mapper.insert: INSERT INTO Customer_Order (member_id, status, total_amount, order_date) VALUES (#{member_id}, 'PENDING', #{total_amount}, SYSTIMESTAMP)
INSERT INTO Order_Item (order_id, book_id, qty, price) VALUES (#{order_id}, #{book_id}, #{qty}, #{price})
mapper.select: SELECT co.order_id, co.member_id, co.status, co.total_amount, co.order_date, c.name AS customer_name FROM Customer_Order co JOIN Member c ON co.member_id = c.member_id ORDER BY co.order_id DESC

SELECT oi.order_item_id, oi.order_id, oi.book_id, oi.qty, oi.price, b.title AS book_title, b.isbn FROM Order_Item oi JOIN Book b ON oi.book_id = b.book_id WHERE oi.order_id = #{order_id} ORDER BY oi.order_item_id ASC
